$comment: Workspace tool paths + settings for the Zenderal patch workspace (Enderal SE). COPY to tools.json (gitignored) and fill in for your machine. Populate/refresh automatically with the `modlist-install` skill, or edit by hand. Use forward slashes; they work fine in PowerShell.
_modlistRoot_help: Root of the installed Zenderal MO2 instance (contains ModOrganizer.exe, mods/, profiles/, tools/). Leave blank if you are not testing against an installed modlist and set the explicit tool paths below instead.
_gameRoot_help: Enderal Special Edition game folder - the one holding SkyrimSE.exe, skse64_loader.exe and 'Enderal Launcher.exe'. This is NOT your Skyrim SE folder; Enderal SE installs as a separate Steam app with its own copy of the engine. With a Wabbajack list this is usually <modlistRoot>/Stock Game (or 'Game Root'), a self-contained copy so the list never touches your Steam install.
_gameDataDir_help: Enderal's Data folder: 'Enderal - Forgotten Stories.esm', the E - *.bsa archives, Scripts/, Source/Scripts/, ScriptsEnderal.zip.
_skyrimSeRoot_help: Your ordinary Skyrim SE install. Enderal ships no Creation Kit and no Papyrus compiler, so both come from here - as does the vanilla Papyrus source (Data/Scripts.zip). Enderal SE is built on the SSE engine, so the SSE CK and compiler are the correct tools; you just point them at Enderal's Data folder.
_papyrusSource_help: The three Papyrus .psc source trees, in PRECEDENCE order. The compiler's -i path is FIRST-WINS (verified on this workspace's toolchain), and Enderal overrides 55 vanilla script names, so Enderal MUST come first or you compile against the wrong signatures. 'enderal': extract <gameDataDir>/ScriptsEnderal.zip once -> its source/scripts folder. 'skse': <gameDataDir>/Source/Scripts (SKSE64 ships its extended vanilla types there in an Enderal install). 'vanilla': extract <skyrimSeRoot>/Data/Scripts.zip once -> its Source/Scripts folder; this is also where TESV_Papyrus_Flags.flg comes from. See CLAUDE.md 'Papyrus toolchain'.
_papyrusFlags_help: User-flags file name, resolved off the -i import path. Ships inside the vanilla Scripts.zip; Enderal's own source trees do not contain one.
_creationKit_help: SSE Creation Kit. To edit Enderal with it you must run it against Enderal's Data folder and set bAllowMultipleMasterLoads=1 - see CLAUDE.md 'Creation Kit against Enderal'. The CK is only needed for the Papyrus compiler and for asset work; all record editing here happens in the Spriggit YAML.
_xedit_help: xEdit executable. For Enderal SE it must run in EnderalSE mode: either use a copy named EnderalSEEdit.exe or pass -EnderalSE. The `xedit-audit` skill passes the switch for you. Plain SSEEdit mode reads the wrong game folder and INI and will not find Enderal's plugins.
_xeditQuickAutoClean_help: xEditQuickAutoClean.exe - headless cleaner (strips ITMs/UDRs/deleted refs). Same xEdit folder; also needs -EnderalSE. Used by `xedit-audit`.
_xeditScriptsDir_help: xEdit 'Edit Scripts' folder (contains 'Check for Errors.pas' etc.) - passed to xEdit -script by `xedit-audit`.
_bsarch_help: BSArch64.exe - CLI BSA packer (bundled in xEdit's folder). Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_synthesis_help: Synthesis.exe - Mutagen patcher pipeline runner. Mutagen supports EnderalSE, so Synthesis can target it. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_resaver_help: ReSaver.exe (Fallrim Tools) - savegame script cleaner (GUI-primary). Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_cao_help: Cathedral Assets Optimizer .exe - mesh/texture optimization, relevant to the visuals pillar. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_nifskope_help: NifSkope.exe - .nif mesh viewer/editor. Reference key; no skill wraps it yet.
_bae_help: bae.exe (Beth Archive Extract) - alternate .bsa extractor. Reference key; `bsa-extract` uses `bsab`.
_modlistsRoot_help: Parent folder of the MO2 instances you install built patches into for testing. May be the same as modlistRoot's parent.
_modsDir_help: The MO2 'mods' folder the `mod-deploy` skill copies dist/<PatchName>/ into, e.g. C:/modding/modlists/Zenderal/mods. Set this rather than letting anything search for it.
_deployModName_help: EXACT folder name to create under modsDir, e.g. 'Zenderal-Bugfixes'. Frequently differs from the .esp name (spaces/dashes/case). A mismatch here is the #1 cause of 'my change never showed up in-game' - MO2 simply doesn't see the folder and the game runs fine without it.
_spriggit_help: gameRelease is Mutagen's GameRelease.EnderalSE - NOT SkyrimSE. It is still served by the Spriggit.Yaml.Skyrim package (EnderalSE maps to GameCategory.Skyrim), but it carries a different implicit base-master set that includes 'Enderal - Forgotten Stories.esm'. Keep this in sync with the repo-root .spriggit file.
_importDirs_help: EXTRA Papyrus source dirs (SkyUI/MCM, PapyrusUtil, other frameworks) appended to the compiler -i path AFTER the three papyrusSource trees. Add as you discover them, and record each in CLAUDE.md's imports table.
